verdict.rationale: Buzz documents its own automation primitives: YAML-as-code automation, workflows triggered via `buzz workflows trigger`, and remote agents that run headless on a substrate such as Kubernetes after deploy. These agents are steered through the relay and are 'purpose-built for headless autonomous coding work.' However, the workflow automation appears mainly as a one-line VISION.md claim. Agents are shown to act on @mention or on a manual trigger, not on a recurring schedule or event-driven background runs. missing for 10: documented scheduled/recurring automation triggers, in-depth workflow YAML docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of background automations running.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
